mapper.insert: INSERT INTO journal_entries (id, global_journal_entry_id, journal_type, name, payment_id, tx_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{globalJournalEntryId}, #{journalType}, #{name}, #{paymentId}, #{txId}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO postings (journal_id, account_code, account_type, amount, direction, currency, created_at) VALUES (#{journalId}, #{accountCode}, #{accountType}, #{amount}, #{direction}, #{currency}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (journal_id, account_code) DO NOTHING
